sources.title: Sigma Detection Format: Rules
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Sysmon：ProcessGuid、父子關係與PID重用
related.titleEn: Sysmon: ProcessGuid, parent relationships and PID reuse
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：75%與90%可重算且recall未下降；例外都有到期/重評條件，不將離線測試當真實攻擊攔阻成效。 交付規則YAML或等價邏輯、100筆標籤及新舊混淆矩陣。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 75% and 90% with unchanged recall; exceptions have review/expiry conditions, and offline tests are not claimed as real-world prevention efficacy. Deliver rule YAML or equivalent logic, 100 labels and before/after confusion matrices.
related.difference: 建立兩個在不同時間重用相同PID的無害程序，再以合成ProcessGuid、ParentProcessGuid、主機與時間組樹；明示程序建立和網路事件的關聯鍵。
related.differenceEn: Create fictional benign processes reusing one PID at different times, then build trees from ProcessGuid, ParentProcessGuid, host and time; define joins between creation and network events.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: precision=TP/(TP+FP)，recall=TP/(TP+FN)；修改過濾器時兩者都要檢查，不能只減少警報。 固定測試集有20個應偵測樣本與80個正常樣本；TP18、FN2、FP6、TN74。 precision=18/(18+6)×100=75%，recall=90%；FP降2且TP維持18時precision=90%。
未壓縮事件資料量=事件數×平均位元組；關聯時PID不是長期唯一鍵，ProcessGuid也需保留主機及收集範圍。 教學每日40000個事件，平均900位元組；不含索引、傳輸與複寫。 40000×900=36000000位元組；加入必要事件類型至60000個後為54000000位元組。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Precision=TP/(TP+FP) and recall=TP/(TP+FN); evaluate both after filtering changes instead of only reducing alert volume. A fixed set has 20 labeled positives and 80 normal fixtures: TP18, FN2, FP6 and TN74. Precision=18/(18+6)×100=75% and recall=90%; reducing FP to 2 with TP18 yields precision 90%.

Uncompressed event volume equals count×average bytes; PID is not a durable identifier, and ProcessGuid joins retain host and collection scope. A teaching day contains 40000 events averaging 900 bytes, excluding indexing, transport and replication. 40000×900=36000000 bytes; increasing required event count to 60000 yields 54000000 bytes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SELinux：型別標籤、DAC 與最小政策修復
related.titleEn: SELinux: type labels, DAC and minimal policy repair
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：75%與90%可重算且recall未下降；例外都有到期/重評條件，不將離線測試當真實攻擊攔阻成效。 交付規則YAML或等價邏輯、100筆標籤及新舊混淆矩陣。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 75% and 90% with unchanged recall; exceptions have review/expiry conditions, and offline tests are not claimed as real-world prevention efficacy. Deliver rule YAML or equivalent logic, 100 labels and before/after confusion matrices.
related.difference: 用合成ls -Z與AVC紀錄列服務domain、檔案type、物件class及permission；先查傳統權限，再查標籤與政策，不直接把整個系統設為permissive。
related.differenceEn: Use synthetic ls -Z and AVC output to identify service domain, file type, object class and permission; inspect DAC, labels and policy instead of making the whole system permissive.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: precision=TP/(TP+FP)，recall=TP/(TP+FN)；修改過濾器時兩者都要檢查，不能只減少警報。 固定測試集有20個應偵測樣本與80個正常樣本；TP18、FN2、FP6、TN74。 precision=18/(18+6)×100=75%，recall=90%；FP降2且TP維持18時precision=90%。
政策驗收矩陣=subject domains×object types×操作類別；允許DAC不代表SELinux允許，反之亦然。 基準4個服務domain、3個檔案type、2種讀寫操作，全部為紙面或隔離測試。 4×3×2=24案；新增第5個服務domain後5×3×2=30案。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Precision=TP/(TP+FP) and recall=TP/(TP+FN); evaluate both after filtering changes instead of only reducing alert volume. A fixed set has 20 labeled positives and 80 normal fixtures: TP18, FN2, FP6 and TN74. Precision=18/(18+6)×100=75% and recall=90%; reducing FP to 2 with TP18 yields precision 90%.

Policy test matrix equals subject domains×object types×operation classes; DAC permission does not imply SELinux permission, or vice versa. Baseline has four service domains, three file types and two read/write operations in paper or isolated tests. 4×3×2=24 tests; adding a fifth service domain gives 5×3×2=30.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
